In this problem set, we will explore some common issues with *staggered treatment DID* setups.

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
packages = c("bacondecomp","tidyverse","ggplot2","plm")

package.check <- lapply(packages, FUN = function(x) {
  if (!require(x, character.only = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(x, dependencies = TRUE)
    library(x, character.only = TRUE)
  }
})

set.seed(121)
```

Run the following code to create a data set of 1000 unique units.  Individuals in half the states are marked as treated.

```{r}
  unit <- tibble(
    unit = 1:1000, 
    unit_fe = rnorm(1000, 0, 0.5),
    # generate state
    state = sample(rep(1:50, 20), 1000, replace = FALSE),
    # generate treatment groups
    treat_group = ifelse(state >= 26, 1, 0),
    # avg yearly treatment effects by group
    hat_gamma = case_when(
      treat_group == 1 ~ 2,
      TRUE ~ 0
    )) %>%
    # generate unit specific yearly treatment effects 
    rowwise() %>% 
    mutate(gamma = ifelse(treat_group == 1, rnorm(1, hat_gamma, .2), 0)) %>% 
    ungroup()
```

The following code will create year fixed effects centered at 0 from 1985-2015, and then combines the unit and year data to create a balanced panel.  The treatment year is set to 1998 and the dependent variable is calculated as the sum of the unit and year FE's, plus the treatment effect (if treated) and an error term.  The dataset is called *DID_not_staggered*.

```{r}
  year <- tibble(
    year = 1980:2015,
    year_fe = rnorm(36, 0, 0.5))
  
  # full interaction of unit X year 
DiD_not_staggered <-  crossing(unit, year) %>% 
    # make error term and get treatment indicators and treatment effects
    mutate(error = rnorm(nrow(.), 0, 0.5),
           treat = ifelse(treat_group == 1 & year >= 1998, 1, 0),
           tau = ifelse(treat == 1, gamma, 0)) %>%
    # calculate the dep variable
    mutate(dep_var = unit_fe + year_fe + tau + error)
```

Run this code to collapse the data by group and plot the time series of the average outcomes.

```{r}
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = dep_var, group = unit), data = DiD_not_staggered) +
  # group specific averages
  geom_line(
    data = . %>% 
      group_by(treat_group, year) %>% 
      summarize(dep_var = mean(dep_var)),
    aes(x = year, y = dep_var, group = factor(treat_group),
        color = factor(treat_group)), size = 1) + 
  labs(x = "", y = "Value", color = "Group") + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1997.5, color = '#4B5F6C',
             linetype = "dashed", size = 1) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("midnightblue", "maroon")) + 
  ggtitle(expression(paste("Not Staggered + Constant ", tau))) + 
  theme(legend.position = 'bottom',
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        axis.title.y = element_text(hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5, angle = 360))

```

The following code recreates the same regression but with *staggered treatment*, with 10 states getting treated in 1985, 10 getting treated in 1995, and 10 getting treated in 2005. Now the dataframe is called *DiD_staggered*.

```{r}
  unit <- tibble(
    unit = 1:1000, 
    unit_fe = rnorm(1000, 0, 0.5),
    # generate state
    state = sample(rep(1:50, 20), 1000, replace = FALSE),
    # generate treatment groups
    treat_group = ifelse(state > 40, 1,
                         ifelse(state <=40 & state > 30, 2,
                                ifelse(state<=30 & state>20,3,0))),
    # avg yearly treatment effects by group
    hat_gamma = case_when(
      treat_group >= 1 ~ 2,
      TRUE ~ 0
    )) %>%
    # generate unit specific yearly treatment effects 
    rowwise() %>% 
    mutate(gamma = ifelse(treat_group >= 1, rnorm(1, hat_gamma, .2), 0)) %>% 
    ungroup()
  
  year <- tibble(
    year = 1980:2015,
    year_fe = rnorm(36, 0, 0.5))
  
  # full interaction of unit X year 
  DiD_staggered <-  crossing(unit, year) %>% 
    # make error term and get treatment indicators and treatment effects
    mutate(error = rnorm(nrow(.), 0, 0.5),
           treat = ifelse(treat_group == 1 & year >= 1985, 1,
                          ifelse(treat_group == 2 & year >= 1995, 1,
                                 ifelse(treat_group == 3 & year >= 2005, 1, 0))),
           tau = ifelse(treat == 1, gamma, 0)) %>%
    # calculate the dep variable
    mutate(dep_var = unit_fe + year_fe + tau + error)

  plm_staggered <- plm(dep_var ~ treat + factor(state),
          data = DiD_staggered, index = c('unit','year'), model = 'within',
          effect = 'twoways')
  summary(plm_staggered)$coefficients

```


Now that we have staggered treatment, we can view the "Goodman-Bacon Decomposition" graph using the code below:

```{r}
df_bacon <- bacon(dep_var ~ treat,
                   data = DiD_staggered,
                   id_var = "unit",
                   time_var = "year")

ggplot(df_bacon) +
  aes(x = weight, y = estimate, shape = factor(type)) +
  labs(x = "Weight", y = "Estimate", shape = "Type") +
  geom_point() + 
  ylim(-3,3)
```

Now, we will incorporate **staggered treatment** with **heterogeneous treatment effects**, with our specific case being treatment effects that grow over time. Instead of a jump of two units at treatment, we will now have a treatment effect that grows at an average of .3 units per year.


```{r}
  unit <- tibble(
    unit = 1:1000, 
    unit_fe = rnorm(1000, 0, 0.5),
    # generate state
    state = sample(rep(1:50, 20), 1000, replace = FALSE),
    # generate treatment groups
    treat_group = ifelse(state > 40, 1,
                         ifelse(state <=40 & state > 30, 2,
                                ifelse(state<=30 & state>20,3,0))),
    # avg yearly treatment effects by group
    hat_gamma = case_when(
      treat_group >= 1 ~ .3,
      TRUE ~ 0
    )) %>%
    # generate unit specific yearly treatment effects 
    rowwise() %>% 
    mutate(gamma = ifelse(treat_group >= 1, rnorm(1, hat_gamma, .1), 0)) %>% 
    ungroup()
  
  year <- tibble(
    year = 1980:2015,
    year_fe = rnorm(36, 0, 0.5))
  
  # full interaction of unit X year 
  DiD_staggered_heterogeneous <-  crossing(unit, year) %>% 
    # make error term and get treatment indicators and treatment effects
    mutate(error = rnorm(nrow(.), 0, 0.5),
           treat = ifelse(treat_group == 1 & year >= 1985, 1,
                          ifelse(treat_group == 2 & year >= 1995, 1,
                                 ifelse(treat_group == 3 & year >= 2005, 1, 0))),
           tau = ifelse(treat == 1, gamma, 0)) %>%
    group_by(unit) %>% 
    mutate(cumtau = cumsum(tau)) %>% 
    mutate(dep_var = unit_fe + year_fe + cumtau + error)

```

Here is the graph to help visualize this:

```{r}
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = dep_var, group = unit), data = DiD_staggered_heterogeneous) +
  # group specific averages
  geom_line(
    data = . %>% 
      group_by(treat_group, year) %>% 
      summarize(dep_var = mean(dep_var)),
    aes(x = year, y = dep_var, group = factor(treat_group),
        color = factor(treat_group)), size = 1) + 
  labs(x = "", y = "Value", color = "Group") + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1984.5, color = '#4B5F6C',
             linetype = "dashed", size = 1) + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1994.5, color = '#4B5F6C',
             linetype = "dashed", size = 1) + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2004.5, color = '#4B5F6C',
             linetype = "dashed", size = 1) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("maroon", "forestgreen","midnightblue","powderblue")) + 
  ggtitle(expression(paste("Staggered + Heterogeneous ", tau))) + 
  theme(legend.position = 'bottom',
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        axis.title.y = element_text(hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5, angle = 360))

```
